maya: Confirmed: registry manifest exists, digest sha256:abcd1234ef56... Running vuln scan now.
ci-bot: Image scan started against registry digest sha256:abcd1234ef56... (scanner: clair-v2).
ci-bot: Scan result: 1 medium CVE (CVE-2024-XXXX) in base glibc. No critical/high. Recommendation: patch base image.
jonah: Can we push to staging despite one medium? I'd prefer proceed to staging but block prod. E2E in staging first.
sre-paul: +1 to staging-only. Medium CVE should be patched before prod. Mark release state: HOLD-PROD. Add rollback plan.
maya: Done — pinned `redwood/api:2.3.1-rc4` to staging. Created PR to update base from `debian:12.1` -> `debian:12.2` (draft). Added note in release ticket about HOLD-PROD and rollback to `redwood/api:2.3.0`.
deploy-bot: DEPLOY STARTED · service `api-staging` · image `redwood/api:2.3.1-rc4` · canary 5%
deploy-bot: CANARY UPDATE · 25% -> rolling to 100%
deploy-bot: DEPLOY FINISHED · api-staging · success · 200/200 pods ready · duration 2m47s
jonah: Kicking off e2e suites: smoke, auth, streaming.
ci-bot: E2E smoke: PASS. Auth suite: intermittent timeout 504 on /login (1/2 retry). Retrying auth tests.
jonah: Investigating auth timeouts — might be session cookie mis-set during canary. Not seeing errors in app logs yet.
maya: Holding prod rollout until base image patch is merged and vuln rescan is clean. Adding prod-change-window note for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Rollback plan: if prod fails, revert to `redwood/api:2.3.0` (tagged) and trigger emergency config rollback.
deploy-bot: IMAGE SCAN SCHEDULED · re-scan on PR merge for image with updated base.
sre-paul: Also add team ping to #incidents if any prod deployment exceeds 5xx threshold >0.5% for 5m.
maya: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll update the release ticket and follow up when the base PR merges.
